arguments.content: Pattern: removing legacy reads before a bounded background migration completes. When a deployment must keep reads available across old and new persisted shapes, new writers using the new shape do not justify removing the old reader branch. Verify the unchanged list consumer against the supported mixed fixture initially, after one bounded batch, and after completion; a single unmigrated record may fail the entire list even when new-write tests pass. In destination reader review (HEAD b299f57e270af63447fb90814bf9fd5cfe45c6cc to staged reader.py), the base passed all states; candidate raised KeyError('destination') initially and after one batch, while completed/repeated migration preserved every address. P1 correction: retain dual-shape reads during migration and cover initial/intermediate/final states.
